common.tagline: Your life certificate, from the comfort of home
common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.title: Sign in with Aadhaar
auth.subtitle: Enter the mobile number that is registered with your Aadhaar. We will take you to Aadhaar to confirm it is you.
auth.demoHint: This is a prototype. Tap a person below to fill in their Aadhaar-registered number.
auth.mobileHelp: This must be the number linked to your Aadhaar — not any other number you use.
auth.redirectNotice: You will be taken to the Aadhaar service to enter your one-time code. JeevanSetu never sees that code.
auth.demoOtp: For this demo, the Aadhaar OTP is always {{code}}.

errors.title: We could not continue
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.directory: We could not load the demo accounts. You can still type an Aadhaar-registered number above.

certificateStatus.title: Life certificate status
certificateStatus.none: You haven't submitted a life certificate yet.
certificateStatus.active: Your certificate is active and your pension is safe.
certificateStatus.expired: Your certificate has expired. Let's renew it — it only takes a few minutes.
certificateStatus.provisional: Your certificate is provisional. Adding one more confirmation makes it fully verified.

dashboard.needAssistance: Ask a family member for help
dashboard.noHistory: No certificates yet — let's create your first one.

verified.label: Fully verified
verified.description: Your certificate is complete for the year.

trusted_device.label: Trusted device
trusted_device.description: This device has been used by you before

face_match.label: Photo match
face_match.description: A quick selfie to confirm it's you

liveness_challenge.label: Liveness check
liveness_challenge.description: A simple action like a smile or blink

voice_phrase.label: Voice check
voice_phrase.description: Say a short phrase out loud

document_upload.label: Document upload
document_upload.description: A photo of your pension document

family_confirmation.label: Family confirmation
family_confirmation.description: A family member confirms it's you

video_verification.label: Video verification
video_verification.description: A short video call with an assistant

manual_review.label: Assisted review
manual_review.description: A person reviews your details personally

verify.startSessionBody: Every step you complete adds to your score. If something doesn't work perfectly, that's alright — we'll always show you another way.

faceMatch.title: Take a quick selfie
faceMatch.body: Look at the camera and make sure your face is clearly visible.

document.title: Upload a document
document.body: A photo of your pension book or ID card works well.

family.title: Ask family to confirm
family.body: We'll send a message to your family member asking them to confirm it's you.
family.sent: Request sent! We'll update your score as soon as they respond.

video.title: Video verification
video.body: A short video call with our verification assistant.

manualReview.title: Ask our team for help
manualReview.body: A verification officer will look at your case and get back to you. This always works — no pressure.
manualReview.pending: A person is reviewing your details now. This usually takes a moment.

verify.notEligibleYet: Keep going — a little more and you'll be ready for your certificate.

certificate.title: Digital Life Certificate
certificate.disclaimer: This is a demonstration certificate generated for a hackathon prototype. It is not issued by any government authority.
certificate.shareCopied: Verification link copied. Anyone with this link can check the certificate is genuine.
certificate.downloadFailed: We could not prepare your certificate PDF.
certificate.redactedNotice: Some personal details are hidden. Sign in as the certificate holder to see the full certificate.
certificate.notFound: We could not find a certificate with that code.
certificate.notFoundHelp: Check the code printed under the QR code and try again.
certificate.provisionalNotice: This is a provisional certificate, valid for 30 days. Complete your verification call to get the full 12-month certificate.
certificate.callRequired: One step left: a verification call
certificate.callRequiredBody: Your confidence score is high enough. A verification officer needs to confirm it is you before the full certificate can be issued.

family.confirmBody: {{name}} needs your help confirming their pension life certificate.
family.thankYou: Thank you! Your confirmation has been recorded.
family.declined: Thanks for letting us know. We'll follow up.
family.addHelp: They will get a message asking them to confirm it's you.
family.demoLink: Demo: open this link to act as the family member.
family.cannotAttestHelp: Aadhaar does not have a verified mobile number for this relative.
family.noneOnRecord: Your Aadhaar record has no family members linked to it.
family.noneOnRecordHelp: That is not a problem — you can still finish with a selfie, a document, or a verification call.

a11y.fontSizeHelp: Make all text larger or smaller
a11y.highContrastHelp: Stronger contrast between text and background
a11y.languageHelp: Choose the language for the whole app

profile.title: My details
profile.subtitle: These are the details on file for your pension. Please check they are correct.
profile.name: Full name
profile.faceIdHelp: A reference photo lets us confirm it's you from a selfie.
profile.readOnlyNotice: These details come from your Aadhaar record and cannot be changed here. To correct them, update your Aadhaar.
profile.faceIdNeedsConsent: Setting up Face ID takes you to Aadhaar to confirm your identity and give consent.
profile.familyReadOnly: Family members are read from your Aadhaar record. They cannot be added or edited here.

camera.blockedBody: No problem at all — you can confirm your identity another way instead.

guidance.multiple_faces: Only one person in the picture, please
guidance.off_centre: Move so your face is inside the circle
guidance.too_dark: A bit more light would help

liveness.title: Liveness check
liveness.intro: This makes sure it's really you in front of the camera, not a photo.

instruction.turn_left: Slowly turn your head to the left
instruction.turn_right: Slowly turn your head to the right

liveness.timeout: We didn't quite catch that — no problem, let's try again or use another way.

enroll.title: Set up Face ID
enroll.intro: We need one reference photo of you. Later, a quick selfie is compared against it to confirm it's you.
enroll.chooseMethod: How would you like to do this?
enroll.selfieBody: Use your camera to capture a clear photo of your face.
enroll.documentBody: Photograph your pension book or ID card — we'll read the photo on it.
enroll.successBody: You can now verify with a quick selfie.
enroll.noFace: We couldn't find a face in that photo. Try again with more light.
enroll.privacy: We store only a mathematical summary of your face, never the photo itself.

voice.title: Voice check
voice.intro: Please read this sentence out loud.
voice.noSpeech: This browser can't understand speech, so we'll just check that you spoke.
voice.micDenied: Microphone permission was blocked. You can allow it, or use another method.

document.title: Upload a document
document.intro: A photo of your pension book or ID card works well.
document.found: We read this from your document:
document.noText: We couldn't read any text. Try a clearer, brighter photo — or use another method.

aadhaar.simulationNotice: Simulated Aadhaar service. This is a hackathon prototype — it is not connected to UIDAI, and no real Aadhaar data is used.
aadhaar.footer: You were sent here by JeevanSetu. Nothing is shared until you agree.
aadhaar.otpSubtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{mobile}}, the mobile registered against Aadhaar {{uid}}.
aadhaar.consentTitle: Share your Aadhaar details with JeevanSetu?
aadhaar.consentBody: JeevanSetu is asking to read the details below so it can issue your life certificate.
aadhaar.faceConsentBody: JeevanSetu wants to register your face against your Aadhaar so a selfie can confirm it is you later.
aadhaar.loginPurpose: Issuing your digital life certificate and confirming your identity when you renew it.
aadhaar.facePurpose: Registering a face template linked to your Aadhaar, so future verification can be done with a selfie from home.
aadhaar.withdrawNotice: You can withdraw this consent at any time from Settings. Withdrawing it also removes your Face ID.

demographics.label: Name, date of birth and gender
demographics.help: Used to print your life certificate and match your pension record.

address.label: Registered address
address.help: Used to confirm you are where your pension record says you are.

family.label: Linked family members
family.help: So a relative on your Aadhaar record can confirm your identity if you need help.

photo.label: Aadhaar photograph
photo.help: Used only to compare against a selfie you take. The photo itself is never stored.

face_authentication.label: Face authentication
face_authentication.help: Lets you verify with a selfie instead of travelling to an office.

consentStatus.title: Aadhaar consent
consentStatus.revoked: Your Aadhaar consent has been withdrawn.
consentStatus.help: JeevanSetu reads your personal details from Aadhaar. Withdrawing consent stops that and removes your Face ID.

pension.title: Pension and payments
pension.subtitle: Every payment made against your passbook number.
pension.noTransactions: No payments have been made against this Aadhaar number.
pension.notEligible: No pension account is linked to this Aadhaar number.

reviews.title: Help requests
reviews.subtitle: Ask a person from our team to look at your case, and follow what happens to your request.
reviews.requestBody: A verification officer will look at your details and get back to you. Nobody reviews requests instantly — you will be told as soon as there is an update, and you do not need to wait on this page.
reviews.messagePlaceholder: For example: my pension stopped three months ago and the selfie check keeps failing.
reviews.created: Request {{ticket}} created. Our team will get back to you.
reviews.none: You have not asked for help yet.
reviews.noneHelp: If something is not working, our team can review your case personally.
reviews.cooldown: You can raise another request on {{date}}.
reviews.cooldownHelp: Requests are spaced {{days}} days apart so the team can work through them properly.
reviews.alreadyOpen: You already have an open request ({{ticket}}). We will come back to you on that one.
reviews.loadError: We could not load your requests.

status.in_review: An officer is looking at it

call.title: Verification call
call.subtitle: A short video call with a verification officer. This is the last step before your life certificate is issued.
call.whyBody: Automated checks can keep your pension running on a provisional certificate. A full 12-month certificate needs a person to confirm it is you — the same way a bank does video KYC.
call.noSlots: No slots are available right now. Please try again later.
call.cancelled: Your verification call has been cancelled.
call.starting: Connecting you to a verification officer…
call.simulatedNotice: Demo: the officer on this call is simulated, and the video is your own camera. The checks, the measurements and the sign-off step work exactly as they would in a real call.

prepare.aadhaar: Keep your Aadhaar card with you
prepare.paper: Have a pen and a sheet of paper ready
prepare.quiet: Find a quiet place where you can speak

checks.title: What the officer will ask you to do

call.integrityBody: While you are on the call we measure a few things that tell a live person apart from a recording or an automated script. Nothing here is stored as video.

flags.static_head_pose: Head did not move at all

call.submit: Finish and send to the officer
call.awaitingOfficer: The verification officer is reviewing your call. You will be told as soon as they confirm.
call.completed: The officer has confirmed your identity. Your life certificate can now be issued.
call.failed: The officer could not complete the verification on this call.
call.operatorBody: In a real deployment this is the officer's screen, not the pensioner's. It is shown here so a demo can complete the flow.

welcome.title: Welcome to JeevanSetu
welcome.body: This is where you prove you are alive so your pension keeps coming — from home, without travelling to an office.
welcome.why: Every year, pensioners have to prove they are alive. Missing it stops the payments.
welcome.next: We will walk through the four things on this page, one at a time.

status.title: Your certificate status
status.body: This card always tells you exactly where you stand and what, if anything, you need to do.
status.why: If something is waiting on you, or waiting on us, it is written here in plain words.
status.next: Next we will look at your pension payments.

pension.title: Your pension and payments
pension.body: Every payment against your passbook number is listed here, including any that are on hold.
pension.why: If your pension has stopped, this page shows you exactly which months are affected and why.
pension.next: Next: how you prove it is you.

verify.title: Proving it is you
verify.body: You build confidence step by step — a selfie, a liveness check, a document, or a relative confirming for you. You can stop and come back any time.
verify.why: If one method does not work for you, another one always will. Nothing dead-ends.
verify.next: Next: the final step before your certificate.

call.title: The verification call
call.body: A short video call with a verification officer is the last step before a full certificate is issued.
call.why: A person confirming your identity is what makes the certificate valid for a full year.
call.next: Last one: where to get help.

help.title: If you get stuck
help.body: You can ask our team to review your case personally. You will get a reference number and can follow what happens.
help.why: Nobody should be locked out of their pension because a camera did not work.
help.next: That is everything. You can replay this tour any time from Settings.
